scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild src/server/vercel-handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=api/index.js
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist server.cjs api/index.js api/index.js.map api/\[...path\].js*
scripts.test:security: tsx -e "import('./src/sdk/testing/SecurityTestRunner.ts').then(m => m.SecurityTestRunner.runAllTests()).then(r => { const passed = r.filter(x => x.status === 'PASSED').length; console.log('Total Tests:', r.length, 'Passed:', passed); if (passed < r.length) process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test: npm run test:serverless && npm run test:security
